custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'text_gibberish' artifact. In real photos, book spines usually have readable titles or at least consistent typographic structures. AI often generates 'fake text' that looks like letters but isn't. Also, verify if the books have realistic thickness and spacing, or if they look like a single textured block.
